en-US.description: The Ultimate Virtual Audio Device Mixer For Windows!
en-US.longDescription: Voicemeeter Potato is the ultimate version of our Audio Mixer Application endowed with Virtual Audio Device to mix and manage any audio sources from or to any audio devices or applications. Dedicated to Voicemeeter expert users, Voicemeeter Potato offers Internal FX (Reverb & MultiTap Delay) and External AUX through Send / Return workflow.
